name: Balanced Softmax weights
tagline: Balanced-Softmax-inspired log-prior weights derived from the gap between log(n_max) and log(n_c).
diff_from_baseline: Inspired by Ren et al., 'Balanced Meta-Softmax' (NeurIPS 2020). Adapts the log-prior shift log(pi_c) into the class-weight API as gentle log-frequency weights, gentler than raw inverse frequency.

name: Class-Balanced Loss
tagline: Effective-number reweighting w_c = (1 - beta) / (1 - beta^{n_c}) with beta=0.9999 and sqrt dampening for stability.
diff_from_baseline: Cui et al., 'Class-Balanced Loss Based on Effective Number of Samples' (CVPR 2019). Treats samples as occupying volume; weight is the inverse expected effective number per class.

name: Inverse-frequency weights
tagline: Standard w_c = N / (C * n_c), with sqrt dampening to prevent VGG-style instability.
diff_from_baseline: Standard statistical reweighting baseline for imbalanced classification. Sqrt dampening reduces dynamic range (e.g. 100x -> 10x on CIFAR-100-LT) while preserving rank ordering.
